title: Upgraded broke G6 (asking for finger sticks)
body:
I started using G6 with the XDRIP version from d1d4887-2018.09.08.
Maybe last week, it told me there's an new version available so I upgraded. I immediately started having problems with invalid data and transmitter failures.
My battery is passed the 100 day mark so I figured that might be part of it.
I finally restarted everything. For some reason, even though I told it I inserted 7 days ago, it still did the 2 hour warmup. Then, it asked me to calibrate with 2 blood sugar readings? Old software never asked me to do that.
I finally gave in to its persistent urging and gave it what it wanted. It then came back and said, "calibration rejected".
This morning, I decided it must be the battery so I switched transmitters. It did the exact same thing (waited for 2 hours and then told me to enter two blood sugar values).
I've since reverted back to the 2018.09.08 software and it's working fine.
I've got a Sony Xperia Compact, but I don't believe it has anything to do with the phone.

It's possible it's just an upgrade problem. When I reverted back, I was so frustrated, I cleared cache and data before uninstalling. Perhaps the upgrade process just left some bad configuration behind? I'm leery to upgrade again at the moment.

comments.body:
Wiped out the data and cache from previous install and re-installed latest stable release. 
All issues went away.
I'm going to close this issue because it's likely impossible to account for all possible upgrade paths anyway and it might have been a bit of user error.
